usage.title: Plan usage
usage.lede: agnts runs on your {agent} plan. These limits are shared with your own {agent} use.
usage.refreshStarted: Refresh started. New numbers arrive in a minute.
usage.warn80: Session usage is above 80%. New runs may pause before they finish.
usage.paused: New runs are paused at the plan limit until {time}.
usage.pausedNoTime: New runs are paused at the plan limit.
usage.source: Read from {agent}'s rate limit events. Includes your own {agent} use on this account.
usage.limitSub: How agnts behaves near the limit
usage.aboveDo: Don't start new runs; runs already going keep going
usage.help: Numbers come from the rate limit events {agent} emits during each run. When agnts is idle, a tiny refresh run keeps them current.
usage.notConnected: No {name} account is connected for you, so there is nothing to read. Connect one on your Profile (or the workspace's in Workspace settings).
usage.museSource: Read from the allowance Muse reports after every run (a Meta subscription's 5-hour and weekly windows). API keys and credits have no windows.
usage.codexBody: Codex runs on the workspace's OpenAI API key and OpenAI bills each call, so there are no plan windows to watch. What its runs cost is in Tickets by spend below.
